title: The 'bubble' energy field mapped over the property

tellings.quote: the bubble that has been mapped using lidar and other platforms

plain: The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for strange events, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that there is a kind of bubble of energy over the land. The owner says this bubble has been mapped using lidar, a tool that measures shapes with laser light, along with other instruments. If true, it would mean something invisible and organised sits over the ranch.
